title: Eliminate affine program states while keeping the AND cost explicit
statement: A Boolean program with n original inputs and t AND gates reduces exactly to a cubic phase sum on n+6t+1 bits, with t cubic monomials and denominator2^(3t+1), independent of the number of affine intermediate states.

requires: Causal XOR/AND program and target bit
Computed affine forms in original inputs and earlier AND results
provides: A Boolean program with n original inputs and t AND gates reduces exactly to a cubic phase sum on n+6t+1 bits, with t cubic monomials and denominator2^(3t+1), independent of the number of affine intermediate states.
assumptions: The resulting quadratic matrix must separately fit an acquired counting interface
t=O(n) is needed for original-n subexponential transfer
costs: Charge all symbolic affine preprocessing; final division after exact summation
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; exact binary/cyclotomic/finite-field arithmetic and source-local rank parameters. No physical resource conversion.
contract.obstruction: Many affine states need not become independent counting variables.

body: Operand and multiplier bits enforce3t+1 constraints; every valid trace is unique for an original input.
